hero.headline: Developer. YouTuber. Editor.
hero.summary: I build Discord bots, Minecraft plugins and mods, websites, creator systems, and the infrastructure behind online communities. I also run falter3d, where I turn Bedwars clips into tightly edited videos.
hero.availability: Availability changes, but my Discord DMs are the best way to reach me.

about.heading: I build across the whole stack of a community.
about.intro: I'm direct about my work, careful with private systems, and focused on making things reliable enough to use outside a demo. I move between code, configuration, editing, and community operations depending on what a project actually needs.
about.quote: I say what I mean, communicate clearly, and care more about a finished result than unnecessary fluff.

projects.title: CloudFun Community Portal
projects.summary: A full community platform developed for CloudFun Network, currently active and in development ahead of its public release.
projects.details: I designed and developed a connected web platform for a Minecraft network rather than a basic landing page. It combines public community features, private submissions, account systems, administration tools, and a visual content editor in one Cloudflare-based application.
features: Secure accounts, sessions, email verification, and password recovery
Discord account linking with automatic role mapping
Forums, reactions, polls, bookmarks, edit history, moderation, and solved answers
Applications, reports, support tickets, wiki pages, and announcements
Granular administration permissions and audit logging
Visual homepage builder with drag, resize, positioning, and layer controls
Protected R2 file uploads and portable D1 backups

projects.title: CloudFun Creators
projects.summary: A private creator-management system developed for CloudFun Network's media and content operations.
projects.details: This system handles the operational side of a creator program across Discord servers. It manages the complete path from applications and rank assignment to content requirements, platform metrics, staff notes, analytics, and recurring reminders.
features: Creator applications, review workflows, closures, and blacklists
Database-driven creator ranks and manager permissions
Content submissions and recurring requirement cycles
YouTube and Twitch metrics with live-viewer tracking
Absences, warnings, notes, health checks, and creator history
Analytics dashboards, reports, exports, panels, and reminders
Invite tracking and collaboration management across multiple servers

projects.title: Security
projects.summary: A Hypixel-linked verification and server security bot developed for YouTuber moxy.
projects.details: Security verifies that a Discord user owns the Minecraft account they claim by comparing their Discord identity with the account linked through Hypixel. It also gives staff controlled override tools and detailed diagnostics for API-related failures.
features: Button and modal-based Hypixel verification flow
Mojang UUID resolution and Hypixel social-link matching
Automatic verified role assignment and Minecraft nickname syncing
Staff verification, removal, lookup, and override controls
Live API-key replacement without restarting the bot
Optional key-expiry alerts that survive restarts
Detailed diagnostics, rate limits, redaction, and audit logging

gallery.caption: moxy, the creator Security was developed for.

projects.title: Permify
projects.summary: A public Discord bot for managing role and channel permissions through structured commands and an interactive control panel.
projects.details: Permify turns Discord permission management into a repeatable workflow. It supports bulk changes, permission syncing, safety confirmations, setup guidance, and per-server change tracking without making administrators edit every role and channel manually.
features: Allow or deny permissions across multiple roles
Apply channel overwrites across multiple channels and roles
Support for role IDs, mentions, and @everyone
Safety mode with confirmations before changes are applied
Per-server change history, logs, and reset tools
Interactive panel and step-by-step setup wizard

projects.title: IndianBedwars Bot
projects.summary: A custom moderation and community-management Discord bot developed for YouTuber IndianBedwars.
projects.details: The bot centralizes the moderation and support workflows needed for IndianBedwars' community, including persistent cases, staff actions, tickets, transcripts, self-roles, and member onboarding.
features: Warnings, mutes, kicks, bans, and persistent case history
Moderation history and individual case lookup
Ticket panels, staff controls, closures, and transcripts
SQLite persistence for moderation and ticket data
Custom configuration for the creator's Discord community

projects.title: Vanish Studios Website
projects.summary: A responsive multi-page company website designed and developed for Vanish Studios.
projects.details: I built the full Vanish Studios web presence, including the visual system, project and team pages, contact flow, legal documents, redirects, responsive behavior, and deployment configuration.
features: Responsive home, projects, team, contact, legal, and error pages
Reusable visual design system and mobile navigation
First-party privacy request form through Netlify Forms
Redirects, custom 404 handling, and deployment configuration
Project and team presentation built without a framework

projects.title: Gory Bot
projects.summary: A full moderation bot built for gvtt3d's Discord server with tickets, appeals, giveaways, reports, logging, and staff activity tools.
projects.details: A large Discord.js moderation project covering case management, community support, reporting, giveaways, message utilities, and internal staff workflows.
features: Warn, mute, kick, ban, temp-ban, and case management
Ticket categories, ratings, and transcript logging
Appeal forms with cooldowns and staff review
Giveaways with role requirements and bonus entries
User reports, staff activity tracking, and message logging

projects.title: VanishItems v2
projects.summary: A rebuilt gear plugin with a configuration-driven ability registry and no hardcoded item logic.
projects.details: Abilities are defined in YAML with their triggers, targets, cooldowns, point costs, and effect stacks, making the system easier to extend without rebuilding core logic.
features: Trigger, target, cooldown, cost, and effect definitions

projects.title: VanishTeams v1
projects.summary: A private BetterTeams fork heavily modified for Vanish SMP's custom team mechanics.
projects.details: The plugin was adapted specifically for the server's requirements and permission structure rather than distributed as a general public fork.

projects.title: VanishItems v1
projects.summary: A custom gear plugin with more than 40 combat, utility, passive, and visual abilities.
projects.details: The first VanishItems release included custom item behavior, armor set bonuses, region awareness, editing tools, and a broad range of gameplay effects.
features: Lifesteal, Shadowstep, Grapple, Homing, and Ore Sight

projects.title: VanishColors v1
projects.summary: A name and chat color plugin supporting standard colors, hex, gradients, and rainbow formatting.
projects.details: VanishColors combined a visual picker with persistent storage, permission-controlled features, and placeholder support.
features: Standard, hex, gradient, and rainbow colors

projects.title: Vanish Discord Bot
projects.summary: A large moderation bot for the Vanish Guild with bilingual support, role hierarchy, moderation commands, and DM notifications.
projects.details: A private Discord.js project that grew beyond 10,000 lines while supporting the guild's moderation and community workflows.
features: More than 10,000 lines of source code

projects.title: Vanish Games Bot
projects.summary: An all-in-one Discord gaming bot with 11 interactive button-based games.
projects.details: The bot managed per-game state, cooldowns, multiplayer interactions, and slash-command entry points for games such as Tic Tac Toe, Blackjack, and Trivia.

projects.title: Custom Currency System
projects.summary: A custom Silver economy with Vault integration, placeholders, leaderboards, and balanced server-wide settings.
projects.details: I designed and configured the economy as a connected server system rather than an isolated currency command.

projects.title: Rank Shop Menu
projects.summary: A complete GUI rank-purchase flow using a custom currency and automated LuckPerms assignment.
projects.details: The system connected menu design, economy requirements, progression tiers, and permission changes into one player-facing experience.

projects.title: Rank Hierarchy
projects.summary: A multi-tier permission structure with inheritance, animated prefixes, and live chat and tab formatting.
projects.details: I configured the full hierarchy and connected it to player-facing displays through LuckPerms, TAB, and PlaceholderAPI.

projects.title: Scoreboard System
projects.summary: An animated scoreboard displaying player rank, currency balance, and live server information.
projects.details: The scoreboard used TAB and PlaceholderAPI to keep player and server data updated in real time.
